sourceSentences: Braum's basic attacks and Winter's Bite each apply a stack of Concussive Blows to their target for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 4 times.
Once the first stack has been applied, any allied champion's basic attack applies an additional stack to the target on-hit.
Unbreakable can be cast during the dash.
If Unbreakable is cast during the dash, Winter's Bite and Glacial Fissure may also be cast.
Stand Behind Me can be used on allied minions but not on wards nor stealthed traps.
The maximum dash range without enemy champions present is ~650. An enemy champion on the far side of the ally will allow Braum to dash a total of up-to 800 units.
If the dash is interrupted, neither Braum nor his ally receive the bonus resistances.
While his shield is raised, Braum also gains 10% bonus movement speed and ghosting.
Unbreakable's full damage reduction can block multiple instances of damage if they're dealt at the same time.
Instantaneously-placed ground-targeted abilities (e.g. Lay Waste, Pillar of Flame, Rupture) relative to the ability's center and not the caster's.
Projectiles that create an area of effect upon their collision will still affect other units and not only Braum.
The damage reduction only benefits Braum.
The first target hit is knocked up for at least 0.6 seconds, increased if they are further away from Braum.
For combos, your go-to is to W into E and Q before attacking away. And your team fight combo is to engage with W into E and alt. From here, attack and Q to
When the fourth stack's applied, all are consumed to deal damage and stun the target.

this can be used to actually extend the distance of his Dash if there's an enemy on the other side of your Ally and you max range cast

it also allows you to move through units so you can use it to avoid creeping

the way professional Brahms play is that they use his w-e the little combo to cancel the cast time so if you're in the middle of jumping to someone and you cast your e while you're flying if you cast your alt or your Q you'll actually cancel the cast time completely and it's a much faster animation

your e actually works on tons of abilities you might not think about such as lux's final spark and on abilities like Bran's pillar of flame and karthus Cube but only if the center of those abilities is in front of your Shield
if you get hit by multiple abilities in the exact same moment and your e damage reduction is up you can actually get 100 damage reduction on multiple abilities at the same time
you block the damage reduction for yourself but you will not block the AOE explosion
